crossRefs.note: Then these men assembled together, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.
They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.
How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?
Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;
But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”
But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief…

people.name: Darius
people.line: Mede who became Emperor over Babylon

translations.web: Then these presidents and local governors assembled together to the king, and said this to him, “King Darius, live forever!
translations.bsb: So the administrators and satraps went together to the king and said, “O King Darius, may you live forever!
translations.kjv: Then these presidents and princes assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.
translations.asv: Then these presidents and satraps assembled together to the king, and said thus unto him, King Darius, live for ever.
